additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Greetings of the day!
With reference to trailing mail, please note
The payment terminal shows the error flag:
PaymentTerminalInitialisationRequired_PZx
sicharge-cp
SYSTEM
true
Payment Terminal requires "initialisation"
An onsite visit is required, to connect to the terminal and initialize it with the terminal ID provided (TID:
40800689
).
If initialization onsite is not successful, please bring a spare terminal unit and replace it. Then initialize the new one with the same TID.
Hence, Onsite visit is required, no further action can be done remotely.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 10/20/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
